basis: jinshu:053:s0034 names 賈后母郭槐 and her attempt to marry 韓壽女 to the prince; zizhitongjian:083:s0126 names 廣城君郭槐 and s0128 repeats this marriage proposal. jinshu:031:s0574 calls her 后母廣城君 and s0575 describes rebuking 賈謐, matching Tongjian s0126–s0127. Chapter031 s0576 explicitly changes her title from 廣城 to 宜城, and s0578 records 宜城臨終執后手，令盡意于太子, corresponding to Tongjian s0131. These full-name, maternal and highly specific incident matches establish one woman across all three records; s0556/s0579 and Tongjian s0077 remain compatible.
